name: 3-in-1 Fast Charging Cable 100W 480Mbps 120cm Type-C Micro Lightning Durable Design
description:
The 3-in-1 Fast Charging Cable is designed to power up all your devices with ease. Featuring Type-C, Micro USB, and Lightning connectors, it supports 100W high-speed charging and 480Mbps data transfer. With a 120cm length and reinforced anti-break design, this cable is durable, reliable, and convenient for home, office, and travel use.
Key Features
 3-in-1 compatibility: Type-C, Micro USB, Lightning
 Supports 100W super-fast charging
 480Mbps high-speed data transfer
 Durable anti-break construction
 120cm length for flexible use
 Ideal for home, office, and travel
Ingredients / Materials
High-quality TPE, braided copper core, reinforced connectors
How to Use
 Plug into compatible power adapter or device
 Select connector based on device port
 Use for charging or data transfer
Package Includes
 1 × 3-in-1 Fast Charging Cable (120cm)
